# faraday_connection (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "faraday_connection" "hosted" {
  name = "hosted"
  options = {
    hosted_csv = {}
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-friendly name of the connection.
- `options` (Attributes) The connection-specific options. These vary by connection type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If not null, this resource will no longer receive updates, but will still be visable.
- `contents` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contents))
- `contents_error` (String) The error encountered when trying to connect, if any
- `created_at` (String) When this resource was created.
- `directionality` (String) Whether the connection can be used as a source (for datasets), a destination (for targets), or both.
- `id` (String) A unique ID for this resource.
- `last_read_input_at` (String) The last time this resource's input was read.
- `last_updated_config_at` (String) The last time this resource's configuration was updated. If this is more recent than last_updated_output_at, the resource will be rebuilt.
- `last_updated_output_at` (String) The last time this resource successfully built.
- `managed` (Boolean) A managed connection requires special configuration from a Faraday admin, and is read-only.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of this resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of this resource and any updates.
- `status_changed_at` (String) When the status of this resource was last updated.
- `status_error` (String) If this resource has `status == "error"`, this will contain an error message.
- `updated_at` (String) When this resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--options--athena"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.athena`

Required:

- `aws_account_id` (String) Twelve-digit AWS account ID that owns the Glue catalog Faraday should query.
- `aws_region` (String) Region of the Glue catalog and the S3 output location, e.g. us-east-1.
- `database` (String) Glue/Athena database Faraday should read from and write to.
- `s3_output_location` (String) s3://bucket/prefix/ where Faraday stages extracts, query results, and target tables. Grant the role in aws_customer_role_arn read and write on this prefix.

Optional:

- `aws_customer_role_arn` (String) IAM role in your AWS account that Faraday assumes to run Athena. Create the Faraday connection first, trust aws_iam_role_arn on this role, then set this field.
- `workgroup` (String) Athena workgroup in your AWS account. Defaults to primary.

Read-Only:

- `aws_iam_role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role Faraday generated for this connection. Create a role in your AWS account that trusts this ARN, grant that role Athena, Glue, and S3, set aws_customer_role_arn, then force-update. Unique per Faraday Athena connection.

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--options--clickhouse"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.clickhouse`

Required:

- `database` (String) Database
- `host` (String) ClickHouse hostname. For ClickHouse Cloud, open Connect, set Connect with to Native (not HTTPS), and copy the host without protocol.
- `port` (Number) Native protocol TLS port. In ClickHouse Cloud, choose Connect with → Native (not HTTPS); the port is typically 9440. HTTPS uses 8443 and will not work. Self-hosted with TLS is often 9440.
- `user` (String) ClickHouse user identified with Faraday's Ed25519 SSH public key.

Optional:

- `load_balancer` (String) In case the host is deployed behind a load balancer.
- `ssh_bastion` (String) In case the host is deployed behind an SSH bastion / jump server. Uses the Faraday SSH public key. This is the address of the bastion including username. For example, faraday@mybastion.example.com

Read-Only:

- `ssh_public_key` (String) Ed25519 OpenSSH public key Faraday generated for this connection. In ClickHouse, create the user with only the base64 segment after ssh-ed25519: CREATE USER ... IDENTIFIED WITH ssh_key BY KEY '<base64>' TYPE 'ssh-ed25519'. Unique per connection. Rotate with the rotate_credentials endpoint.


<a id="nestedatt--options--databricks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.databricks`

Required:

- `catalog` (String) Unity Catalog catalog Faraday should use.
- `host` (String) Databricks workspace server hostname, without protocol. Copy it from the SQL warehouse Connection details. Example: adb-1234567890123456.1.azuredatabricks.net or xxx.cloud.databricks.com.
- `http_path` (String) SQL warehouse HTTP path from the warehouse Connection details. Example: /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123def456.
- `schema` (String) Schema within the catalog Faraday should use.

Optional:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Databricks personal access token for a service principal or user Faraday should authenticate as.


<a id="nestedatt--options--databricks_delta_sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.databricks_delta_sharing`

Required:

- `schema_name` (String) The schema name within the Delta Sharing share.
- `share_name` (String) The name of the Delta Sharing share.

Optional:

- `credentials_json` (String, Sensitive) The Delta Sharing credentials JSON file contents. Download this file from the activation link provided by Databricks, then paste its contents here, and finally delete the file from your local computer.

<a id="nestedatt--options--sftp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.sftp`

Required:

- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the SFTP server
- `port` (Number) The port on the SFTP server listening for connections
- `user` (String) The user to connect to the SFTP server as

Optional:

- `compression` (Boolean) The compression algorithm to use
- `encryption` (String) The encryption cipher(s) to use
- `host_key` (String) The host key algorithm to use in verifying the host key presented by the remote host
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Optional password to connect. If blank, Faraday's private key will be used instead.

<a id="nestedatt--options--snowflake"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.snowflake`

Required:

- `database` (String) Database
- `user` (String) Snowflake user.
- `warehouse` (String) Warehouse

Optional:

- `account_name` (String) Snowflake account name. If provided, also provide organization name. ORGNAME-ACCOUNTNAME.snowflakecomputing.com. Preferred over legacy account locator. https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/admin-account-identifier.html#format-1-preferred-account-name-in-your-organization.
- `legacy_account_locator` (String) NOT needed if organization name is provided. If your Snowflake account existed before the Organizations feature was enabled, the Format 2 (Legacy): Account Locator in a Region is used as the account name.
- `organization_name` (String) Snowflake organization name. If provided, also provide account name. ORGNAME-ACCOUNTNAME.snowflakecomputing.com. Preferred over legacy account locator. https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/admin-account-identifier.html#format-1-preferred-account-name-in-your-organization.
- `role` (String) The Snowflake role that will be used by Faraday to connect to the instance (Usually this is FARADAY).
- `schema` (String) Snowflake schema name. If not provided, it may be provided at the dataset level, or omitted entirely.

Read-Only:

- `rsa_public_key` (String) RSA public key that should be assigned to the Snowflake user. Unique per Faraday Snowflake connection. Set by the Faraday system. Use the rotate_credentials endpoint to regenerate.

<a id="nestedatt--options--stripe"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.stripe`

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the Stripe connection
- `username` (String) Username for the Stripe connection


<a id="nestedatt--options--the_trade_desk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.the_trade_desk`

Required:

- `advertiser_id` (String) Refer to <a href="https://hightouch.com/docs/destinations/tradedesk#first-party-data-segment-credentials">the HighTouch docs</a>.

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) To generate an API token you must contact your TradeDesk rep and ask for CRM Data Management Access. Refer to <a href="https://hightouch.com/docs/destinations/tradedesk#crm-data-segment-credentials">the HighTouch docs</a>.
- `environment` (String) Select a server location of your choice. If unspecified, defaults to 'production'. Refer to <a href="https://hightouch.com/docs/destinations/tradedesk#first-party-data-segment-credentials">the HighTouch docs</a>.


<a id="nestedatt--options--tiktok"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.tiktok`

Optional:

- `tiktok_account_id` (String) Account id for the TikTok connection



<a id="nestedatt--contents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contents`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of a table or object found in the connection
- `object_size` (Number) Object size in bytes. Only applicable to object stores (S3, GCS, etc).
- `row_count` (Number) Row count if available from this connection type. Only applicable to databases and data warehouses. Some do not have an efficient row count mechanism (e.g. Postgres) and so this is not provided.
